note: Organic content-to-pipeline building blocks: the 3-pillar weekly mix, 5 post-type skeletons, 6 viral wrapper shapes, cadence rows, content-team roles, the 4-part positioning formula, proof-library categories, distribution channels, metric tiers, Instagram top-of-funnel rules, and (from the 200k-impression-system augment) the source-content repurposing method, the 3 convert-buckets, the 60-minute daily rhythm, CTA-by-goal frameworks, the weekly posting schedule, and the content-to-pipeline signal-capture flow. This bank is authored, not measured — impression/conversion figures circulating for this system (200k impressions, 23 calls in 14 days, etc.) are the sources' own claims and agents must not present them as proven. A fuller playbook lives in the shared skills shelf as the organic-reach-gtm skill. Hard rules that travel with every row: proof is never fabricated (no invented results, testimonials, or screenshots — real proof or no post), every comment-keyword CTA's promised DM is actually sent by a human or human-approved draft, scheduling goes through platform-native schedulers only, comments on others' posts follow the linkedin bank's human-approval rules, and capturing engagers on a post is done with platform-native or manual review — third-party scrapers and fully-automated mass-DM tools violate platform terms and are never used. Slots are UPPERCASE so an unfilled template trips the placeholder check in src/lib/services/deliverables/acceptance-contracts.ts.

postTypes.template:
[BOLD CLAIM ABOUT THE RESULT THE RESOURCE DELIVERS]

What's inside:
[THREE TO FIVE SPECIFIC COMPONENTS AS BULLETS]

[OPTIONAL ONE LINE OF SOCIAL PROOF]

Comment [KEYWORD] and I'll DM it.
postTypes.why: Highest-converting type; the keyword comment creates a DM channel and boosts distribution. Every promised DM must actually be sent.

postTypes.template:
[RESULT HEADLINE WITH A SPECIFIC NUMBER]

The constraint: [TIME OR BUDGET OR TEAM SIZE]

The exact steps:
[THREE TO FIVE NUMBERED STEPS]

What I'd do differently: [ONE HONEST CHANGE]
postTypes.why: Numbers, process, constraint, outcome — show the work. The result must be real.

postTypes.template:
[THE SPECIFIC MISTAKE]

What it cost: [TIME OR MONEY OR OPPORTUNITY]

What I do instead now: [THE CHANGE]

The result: [WHAT IMPROVED]
postTypes.why: Specific vulnerability builds trust generic advice cannot.

postTypes.template:
[THE OUTCOME THE READER WANTS]

[THREE TO FIVE STEPS OF AT MOST TEN WORDS EACH]

Common objection: [OBJECTION] - [YOUR ANSWER]

[CTA TO GO DEEPER]
postTypes.why: Tactical and immediately applicable; step brevity is the discipline.

postTypes.template:
[COMMON PRACTICE] is [DEAD OR WRONG OR OUTDATED].

Why it stopped working: [REASON]

What works instead: [YOUR APPROACH]

The evidence: [SPECIFIC PROOF]
postTypes.why: Strong POV draws comments and DMs; the position must be genuinely held and evidenced.

viralWrappers.shape: tried a thing for a fixed period: before state, the change, after state with metrics, tactics used, CTA
a list with a specific use case per item, tagging tools or creators for amplification, with a screenshot of the real stack
call out the common belief, present the contrarian take with data, three to five supporting points, invite pushback
how a company went from X to Y: starting position, exact system, tools, results with timeline, how to replicate
year-vs-year contrast, the pivot, tactical steps, current state with proof, lessons
the exact workflow behind a result: numbered steps, tools per step, screenshots, failure points, CTA for the full SOP

cadence.rhythm: 5 posts per week, one per weekday
10 meaningful comments per day: 5 on ICP posts, 3 on aspirational accounts, 2 on peers; meaningful means 2-3 sentences referencing a specific point
respond to every comment on your own posts within about 2 hours

teamRoles.owns: ideation from positioning and results, all writing, asset briefs, review, scheduling; a strategist who writes
teamRoles.hiringTest: paid test: three post ideas from real positioning and results, one written out

teamRoles.owns: every DM conversation and comment reply, ICP-post commenting, lead-magnet follow-up, qualification, booking
teamRoles.hiringTest: ten real DM threads: do they qualify properly and sound human

teamRoles.owns: brand visual style, preview media from briefs, lead-magnet visuals, 24-48h turnaround
teamRoles.hiringTest: three preview images from a real brief

productionRule: rolling weekly cycle with one hard deadline: all of next week's content written, designed, reviewed, and scheduled by end of Friday, through the platform's native scheduler only

positioningFormula.rule: a specific ICP with size and role, never a broad category
a transformation with numbers and a timeframe, never a vague benefit
a named method, never a generic capability
measurable evidence, never a volume-of-experience claim

signatureFramework: one named framework per authority: a memorable two-to-four word name, three to five components, a visual diagram, a clear before/after, and real attached proof; referenced in every post and every sales conversation

proofLibrary.spec: 10+ entries: company, start and end metrics, timeframe, tactics, screenshot or testimonial - all real
dashboards, pipeline, reply and conversion rates, stack cost vs return
real automation screenshots, enrichment tables, sequences and templates with their actual reply rates
3-5: background, problem, step-by-step solution, tools, results with timeline, lessons

distribution.role: core: the weekly posting and commenting engine
owned: weekly deep-dive on one framework or tactic
leverage: guest posts, podcasts, co-created lead magnets
scale: video, audio, blog, and social cutdowns of the same source document

metricTiers.metrics: qualified DM conversations started, discovery calls booked, newsletter subscribers, clients signed
follower growth (quality over quantity), impressions, ICP comments
new case studies per quarter, testimonials collected, mentions and collaborations
revenue from inbound - buyers who found you; if it rises monthly the system works

instagramRules.detail: works for low-friction PLG tools, visually-provable services for SMBs and founders, and info products; not for enterprise cycles, demo-led setup-heavy products, or committee purchases
attention, problem awareness, and one micro-conversion (download, trial, waitlist); closing, nurture, and retention live elsewhere

instagramRules.rule: teach one thing completely in under 90 seconds
instagramRules.detail: create a gap the lead magnet closes, and point every post at it via caption CTA and bio link
intercept with value, then move to a buying environment; downloads pre-qualify by topic (their pain, their stack, their willingness to act)

instagramRules.rule: for cold traffic, trials beat demos
instagramRules.detail: instant access, zero friction, self-qualification through product use

sourceContentMethod.step: write one deep source piece per week
sourceContentMethod.detail: a detailed case study, step-by-step system breakdown, contrarian take with evidence, or a framework you actually use - substantial enough to be a mini-course; 30-60 minutes once, it fuels everything else

sourceContentMethod.step: break the source into a 7-day content run
sourceContentMethod.detail: day 1 the contrarian hook, day 2 the step-by-step breakdown, day 3 the mistake post, day 4 the proof post, day 5 a thread version, day 6 a carousel or visual, day 7 the long newsletter

one source becomes LinkedIn posts, threads, short-form video, newsletter, and community posts; roughly one source = seven-plus pieces, four sources a month = twenty-eight-plus posts, most of the time spent distributing not creating

sourceContentMath: one source piece yields seven-plus derived pieces; four source pieces a month is twenty-eight-plus posts on roughly four hours of monthly creation, with the rest of the effort spent on distribution

convertBuckets.post: case studies with real numbers, results screenshots, permissioned client wins, before/after comparisons, dashboard snapshots
convertBuckets.why: people don't trust claims, they trust evidence - and the evidence must be real

convertBuckets.post: how-to posts with steps, frameworks they can apply today, tactical breakdowns, tool tutorials, process explanations
convertBuckets.why: teaching is the fastest way to build trust

convertBuckets.post: strong opinions on your space, what you stand against, reasoned hot takes, this-is-what-we-believe posts, industry predictions
convertBuckets.why: people follow people who stand for something; the position must be genuinely held

dailyRhythm.actions: post the day's content, reply to every comment for the next 45 minutes, clear overnight and morning DMs, engage on 5-10 posts from ICP accounts, reply to any stragglers on yesterday's post
engage on 5-10 more ICP posts, send DMs to 2nd-degree ICP connections who engaged with your content, save high-performing posts to a swipe file

leave 2-3 sentence thoughtful comments not bare likes, comment on the same accounts repeatedly so the algorithm rewards the relationship, turn on notifications for 10-15 key accounts, and block the time on the calendar or it won't happen

ctaByGoal.template: Comment [KEYWORD] and I'll DM you the [RESOURCE].
ctaByGoal.note: every promised DM is actually delivered by a human or human-approved draft

ctaByGoal.template: What [TOOL OR SYSTEM OR METHOD] do you use for [SPECIFIC USE CASE]? Drop it below.
ctaByGoal.note: a low-stakes question earns comments and surfaces intent

ctaByGoal.template: Agree? Disagree? Let me know in the comments.
ctaByGoal.note: invites debate on a genuinely held position

ctaByGoal.template: Repost this if you know someone who needs it.
ctaByGoal.note: reach expansion; only ask when the piece genuinely warrants it

weeklySchedule.why: people want actionable content to start the week
credibility day - show your work with real numbers
end the week on a high with a real win

postingTimes: commonly effective LinkedIn windows are roughly 8-9am, 12-1pm, and 5-6pm local; these are starting points, not laws - test and find what works for your own audience

contentToPipeline.action: review the likers, filter for ICP fit by title, company size, and industry, and route the genuine matches to a human-approved DM conversation
review the commenters, personalize off what they actually said, and send human-approved outreach that references their specific comment

contentToPipeline.signal: a lead-magnet post earns many comments
contentToPipeline.action: deliver the promised resource, follow up about 48 hours later, and book calls from the warm ones

contentToPipelineRule: engagement on your own posts is a legitimate warm signal, but capturing it stays within platform terms: use the platform's native surfaces or manual review and human-approved DMs; third-party engager-scrapers and fully-automated mass-DM tools violate platform terms and are never used
